goal.statement: Every product lookup by cashier returns correct store-scoped results in < 200ms, and price changes never retroactively modify existing order items.
goal.metric: Cashier product search latency p95 < 200ms. Zero cross-store product leaks. Zero order items with retroactively changed price.

actors.name: Store Manager / Quản lý cửa hàng
actors.goal: Maintain an accurate and current product catalog

impacts.action: Create product with correct VNĐ price + VAT rate
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Cashiers cannot find products to sell
Sales at wrong price without audit trail
Cashiers try to sell products no longer available

actors.name: Admin
actors.goal: Oversee product catalog across all stores

impacts.action: View and manage all stores' products
impacts.deliverable: Admin role bypass on product endpoints
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Admin cannot audit product inconsistencies across stores

actors.name: Cashier / Thu ngân
actors.goal: Find products quickly when processing a sale

impacts.action: Search product by name or SKU (Vietnamese diacritic-insensitive)
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Cashier cannot find 'Bánh Mì' by typing 'banh mi' — slows down POS

impacts.action: Get product details by ID before adding to order
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Cashier cannot confirm price before checkout

actors.name: Order System (downstream consumer)
actors.goal: Snapshot product price and VAT at order-item creation time

impacts.action: Read product.priceVnd + product.taxRatePercent at item-add time
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Historical orders reflect future price changes — accounting error

constraints: storeId on every product query MUST come from JWT — never from URL or body
unaccent PostgreSQL extension must be enabled before product search is usable
Soft-delete only — no Product rows may be hard-deleted
